name: GHEM
original_description: GHEM helps creators and businesses produce product images and videos from written descriptions and visual references. Connect your GHEM account, choose a supported model and settings, approve each generation, and view or save the result. Upload reference files, reuse named products and characters, and organize your work into projects. Reference files must be selected in the GHEM upload view or imported from a supported direct HTTPS link; the plugin does not automatically access chat attachments.

limitations_ja: GHEMアカウントを接続する。参考ファイルは専用画面または対応する直接HTTPSリンクから取り込み、チャット添付を自動取得しない。
